comment: md013 (line length) is off: table rows cannot be wrapped, and this repository
uses tables whose rows reach 250 characters. The ~100 column prose convention
stays a convention. A rule that cannot be satisfied is worse than no rule.
md040 (fenced code language) is off: an accepted decision record violates it,
and accepted records are immutable apart from Status, so it can never pass.
Everything else is enabled and currently passes.
